items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: Well, we had a brother, a fellow by the name, Sport Young.

ctx.x: Who else was working with you there?
Well, we had a brother, a fellow by the name, Sport Young. Oh, yeah.

items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Yeah, Austin Young's play trombone. Oh, he was there.

ctx.x: Oh boy, it was something. It was pretty rough. Then I went to Budweiser dance hall in 35. Me and René went to that 35. Who was there at the Budweiser? Budweiser dance hall? Right there next to La Vida. You remember? Yeah, but I mean, who was with you? You had René? Me, René, Ducaugier, Ducaugier on piano, Butler rap, Gaillier they call guitar. Yeah. And Spurt on saxophone, played saxophone. Austin Young's brother? Austin Young's brother? Yeah, Austin Young's play trombone. Oh, he was there. And Eddie Handy played…
